---
title: Show how one result varies over two inputs
description: A surface chart draws a measure over two numeric inputs as a mesh seen from an angle, coloured by its height, so the reader sees where it peaks.
version: 0.0.1
styles: [scientific]
---

## Yield peaks in the middle of the field

These illustrative yields come from a complete grid of water and nitrogen levels, so RichView draws the mesh as given. Rows that do not fill a grid are interpolated onto one and the readout says so. The default view looks from 35 degrees round and 28 degrees above; `style.azimuth` and `style.elevation` change it.
